checkService.title: Check that service beans implement their interfaces
checkService.description: Report a service bean that does not implement an exported interface.

checkListener.title: Check listeners
checkListener.description: Report listener methods that are missing or have a wrong signature, and listeners that do not implement OsgiServiceLifecycleListener.

checkUnresolvedRef.title: Hint at unknown bean references
checkUnresolvedRef.description: Show an Info hint for a ref that no project source defines. Library beans are invisible, so it can over-report.

checkElements.title: Check OSGi elements and attribute values
checkElements.description: Report conflicting declarations, such as interface with interfaces, and invalid attribute values.
